senses.gloss: m. (קְטַר II) wreathing, ק׳ בידי (= בי ידי) plaiting the sleeves of garments;

units: Bets. 23ᵃ קי׳ שרי Ms. M. (ed. קט׳) ḳiṭṭura on the Holy Day is allowed; מאי ק׳ אי ק׳ בידי (Ms. M. קִיטּוּרֵי, pl. constr.) what ḳiṭṭura is meant? If plaiting be meant, (how can it be permitted,) is it not an artisan’s work? and if perfuming be meant, &c.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 10b:4">M. Kat. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>קִיטּוֵּרי בידי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בירי</he>; Ms. Alf. <he>בי ידי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) plaiting sleeves during the festive week is forbidden.
